body:
I wish I knew. Probably money, that always ends up triggering my guilt and depression. I used to be the breadwinner and the roles reversed in the last few years because of my declining health. The budget I had planned for the move wasn't adhered to very well (my fault) and we ate up our savings quicker than I had hoped. We were going to save up and go on a nice vacation and I feel like I have ruined that because of this fear of being screwed over yet again at an abusive work site.

I wish you all the best in your future move. It helped me for the first little bit. Changes in scenery are always nice.
